A.description: Current PersistentBM25.search implementation (postings JOIN documents per term, no preload, default SQLite PRAGMAs).

B.description: Preload (id -> length) and (id -> interned case_id) in memory; query postings without JOIN documents; default SQLite PRAGMAs.

C.description: Variant B + explicit read-only SQLite PRAGMAs (mmap_size=4GiB, cache_size=512MiB, temp_store=MEMORY).
